info.title: Wikidown CLI
info.description: Command-line tool for maintaining a Wikidown /docs wiki. List, read, write, move, reorder, and search pages while keeping .order files consistent.

commands.name: backfill-breadcrumbs
commands.description:
add/refresh the breadcrumb line
on every existing page that predates it (write/move do this
automatically going forward; this is a one-time catch-up)
export-pdf --output <path> [--title T] [--from /Link/Path]
[--no-toc] [--no-cover] [--allow-html-skip]
combine the wiki (or a subtree) into one linked PDF
init     [--agents claude|copilot|all|none] [--force]
seed the wiki and install AI agent configs (Claude Code +
GitHub Copilot) in the folder containing the wiki root
pages    [--title T] [--force]
scaffold a Jekyll site + starter theme into the wiki root so
GitHub Pages can publish it; (re)generates _data/navigation.yml
export-html --output <dir> [--base-url /prefix] [--title T] [--clean]
render the wiki to a static HTML site with the same theme, no
Jekyll/Ruby needed — for GitLab Pages, any static host, or local preview
